posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
Let's start a game of Mastermind! I will start by creating the code, and anyone here can make a guess (we will change next game). Instead of colors, we will use the numbers 1-6, and the same number can be used more than once. You guess a 4-digit code using the numbers 1-6. You will have 12 guesses (put the number by each one), and after each guess I will say how many numbers are correct but in the wrong place, and how many are correct and in the right place.

OK, I got a code (rolled 4d6). Who will be the first one to guess!
